<a2ui>
surface("status-list")
filter = segmented_control([{label: "All", value: "all"}, {label: "Active", value: "active"}, {label: "Pending", value: "pending"}, {label: "Blocked", value: "blocked"}, {label: "Done", value: "done"}], "all", "status_filter")
list = entity_list([{name: "Migrate billing service", subtitle: "Moving invoices to the new ledger API", status: "Active"}, {name: "Update onboarding emails", subtitle: "Copy review is underway with marketing", status: "Pending"}, {name: "Fix SSO redirect loop", subtitle: "Waiting on identity provider fix", status: "Blocked"}, {name: "Publish Q3 report", subtitle: "Final PDF shared with stakeholders", status: "Done"}, {name: "Refactor search indexer", subtitle: "Cutting reindex time by about 40%", status: "Active"}, {name: "Renew TLS certificates", subtitle: "Scheduled for the next maintenance window", status: "Pending"}, {name: "Provision staging database", subtitle: "Blocked by missing cloud quota approval", status: "Blocked"}, {name: "Archive legacy logs", subtitle: "Retention job completed successfully", status: "Done"}])
root = columns(2, "1.5rem", "top", [{blocks: [heading("Filter by status"), filter]}, {blocks: [heading("Work items"), list]}])
</a2ui>

The catalog has no component with built-in list filtering that I could wire up. This layout puts a status filter (All, Active, Pending, Blocked, Done) next to the eight-item list. The filter is not connected to the list, so selecting a status will not hide any items.
